messages.subject: unexpected genotypes
parts:
I uploaded a set of genotype with the following, then I got an error code, I don't think I have unexpected genotypes "B"? But what is the possible reason for this? Thank you in advance. I did notice there might be a blank in from of the B (| B| instead of |B|), but I don't think it is in my genotyping data.

data <- read.cross("csvsr",dir="",genfile="updated.csv", phefile="without_parents.csv", na.strings=c("-", "NA"), genotypes=c("A", "B"))

In read.cross.csvs(dir, genfile, phefile, na.strings, genotypes,  :
  The following unexpected genotype codes were treated as missing.
    |H| B|
